name: NYPlug New York Power Group
description:
A multi-story power company building with **multiple entry points**.

- Additional entrance at the rear
- **Player spawn point** nearby

- **Third floor requires a key** to enter

name: Activity-Full Sphere Solutions
description:
A **large multi-story office building** with a hidden safe.

### Building Layout
- Multiple entrances including a side entrance
- Two staircases throughout the building
- Storage space on lower floors

### Safe Location
The **safe is located on the second-to-last floor**. When using the front staircase (southwest), go left upon reaching that floor.

### Navigation Tips
- Front staircase (SW) continues to the rooftop
- Rear staircase terminates at the penultimate floor

Follow the hallways on the first floor to reach the NYPlug building.

### Warnings
- **Player spawn location** on upper floors
- Medium to large zombie spawns at night

This building serves as both a spawn point and a connector between the apartment complex and NYPlug.

name: Water Treatment Plant (Site C)
description:
The **most dangerous zombie location** in the game, the *Water Treatment Plant*, also known as *Site C*.

### Threat Level: EXTREME
- Most aggressive zombie spawns in the game
- Highest zombie population density
- Zombies can spawn directly in front of you

### Location
Located under the bridge with an underground sewer system.

### Recommended Strategy
- **Bring a team** - solo runs are nearly impossible
- Shoot zombies in the legs to immobilize and prevent respawns
- Have one teammate lure zombies while another moves in
- Utilise the smaller sewage tunnels shown in the images

*Do not attempt alone.*

**Warning**: Getting spotted will aggro the horde below.
